description: Push the CRM's current price and stock to the workspace's existing Amazon offers now — the same as the Amazon connection page's sync button; an hourly job does it anyway, so use it only when a change must reach Amazon before the next run. It runs only the directions the owner ALREADY armed (price push, stock push) and never arms anything: price only in the marketplace's currency, stock only for products that track it and only for MFN offers (FBA stock is Amazon's). A product taken off the channel or paused is skipped. Refused until the owner switches on AI publishing. Returns matched, updated and total. Not idempotent in the sense of timing, but sending the same numbers again changes nothing on Amazon. The result echoes the workspace.
name: sync_amazon_offers
title: Sync Amazon offers
